arena.name: KUET campus
arena.subtitle: Khulna University of Engineering and Technology

location.name: Central Library
location.clue: The building full of books and silent readers.
Borrowing is free here, but late returns cost you.
Where knowledge sleeps on shelves until someone wakes it.

location.name: Administrative Building
location.clue: Where the university's official papers are handled.
Every certificate and notice begins its journey here.
The desk where a student's fate is stamped and signed.

location.name: Central Mosque
location.clue: A place of prayer on campus.
A calm place where the day is measured in prayers.
Five times a day, a call from here is heard across campus.

location.name: Shaheed Minar
location.clue: A monument that remembers the language movement.
Flowers are laid here every February.
Bare feet and a sunrise procession on the twenty-first.

location.name: Central Cafeteria
location.clue: Where students go to eat and drink tea.
Tea, snacks and the loudest conversations on campus.
Empty stomachs, full tables and the best gossip in town.

location.name: Main Gate
location.clue: The entrance of the campus.
Everyone enters through here, nobody ignores it.
The first thing a visitor meets and the last thing they leave behind.

location.name: Sports Ground
location.clue: A big open field for sports.
Wide open grass where matches begin at sunset.
Eleven players, one ball and a crowd that never sits still.

location.name: Auditorium
location.clue: A big hall with a stage and many seats.
Seminars, cultural nights and convocations happen here.
Where graduates wait for their names to be called.

location.name: Student Hall
location.clue: Where students live and sleep.
Rooms, corridors and midnight snacks.
A home away from home with a curfew and a roommate.

location.name: Workshop Building
location.clue: Where engineering students work with machines and tools.
Sparks, metal and the smell of oil.
Theory ends at the door and hands-on learning begins.

location.name: Campus Pond
location.clue: A small water body on campus.
Calm water where evening walks end.
Ducks, reflections and the quietest bench on campus.

location.name: Medical Center
location.clue: Where sick students get checked by a doctor.
The first stop for fevers, cuts and headaches.
Where a white coat and a prescription pad wait for you.
